description: representative-port (overview-data-split Phase 2): port 3 representative tasks (perf-WS3, 1b-multidev, polish-Fs) into OVERVIEW_DATA.tasks[], add a synchronous renderTasks() at the top of the main inline <script> in plans/overview.html, emit both section markers (renderTasks body + renderPhaseTree empty stub) so US-004 has a defined slot, implement <details> open-state preserve/restore around wipe-and-render, and delete the 3 original HTML blocks only after pixel-identical verification. The remaining 48 tasks stay HTML-authored until full-task-port.

userStories.title: Establish render pipeline + port 3 representative tasks + open-state preserve/restore
userStories.description: As a bookkeeper, I want renderTasks() to data-drive 3 representative tasks (perf-WS3 shipped+mergeCommit, 1b-multidev multiple-kanban-cards, polish-Fs rich warnings) while the other 48 stay HTML-authored, so that the render pipeline + DOM contracts + <details> open-state preservation are validated before the bulk port.
acceptanceCriteria: Section markers `// ===== renderTasks() =====` and `// ===== renderPhaseTree() =====` exist near the top of the main inline <script> block in plans/overview.html (US-004 will fill the phase-tree marker; this story emits an empty stub function).
renderTasks() runs synchronously at the top of the main inline <script> (line 2614+), BEFORE the first DOM-walking IIFE (PHASE_TO_ORDER_BUCKET / renderPhaseBadges / counts / filters).
renderTasks() calls getRoadmapData() (rewired by US-001/foundation to return window.OVERVIEW_DATA) rather than reading the global directly, to stay consistent with existing IIFEs.
OVERVIEW_DATA.tasks[] in plans/overview-data.js contains exactly 3 entries with id values 'perf-WS3', '1b-multidev', and 'polish-Fs', each with full command, kanbanCards[], and schema-correct fields.

perf-WS3 entry has phase='shipped' and a populated mergeCommit field; 1b-multidev entry has more than one kanbanCards[] element; polish-Fs entry has a non-empty command.warnings[] array with rich html content.

kanbanCards[] entries follow the schema {column: 'ready'|'soon'|'blocked', cardClass: string|null, inlineStyle: string|null, html: string}; rich .card-meta content (pills, icons, links, inline <code>) round-trips verbatim from the original HTML.

Render emits each kanban card as `
${card.html}
` into the matching #kanban-ready / #kanban-soon / #kanban-blocked container based on card.column.

Render emits each command row as `<details class="cmd" id="cmd-${task.id}" data-task-id="${task.id}" data-task-scope="${task.scope}" data-task-phase="${task.phase}" data-task-status="${task.status}"${task.planOnly ? ' data-plan-only="true"' : ''}${task.mergeCommit ? ' data-merge-commit="' + task.mergeCommit + '"' : ''}>` into #cmd-list.

Prompt bodies in <pre class="cmd-pre"> are written via textContent (or document.createTextNode) — NEVER via innerHTML or template-string interpolation into an HTML fragment. Verified by manual copy-paste check: pasted text from the rendered .cmd-pre equals the JS string literal stored in tasks[].command.planPrompt byte-for-byte, including shell metacharacters like `2>&1` (not `2>&1`).

HTML entities (<, >, &, etc.) in prompt strings are decoded once at port time when authoring the JS string literals in tasks[].command.planPrompt; the render path's textContent assignment then round-trips them as literal characters.

The 3 data-rendered rows are visually pixel-identical to the (still-present) original HTML rows during development; the 3 original HTML blocks (kanban cards AND <details class="cmd"> rows for perf-WS3, 1b-multidev, polish-Fs) are deleted from plans/overview.html by end of story, only after the pixel-identical verification.

Open-state preserve/restore: renderTasks() snapshots `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('details.cmd[open]')).map(el => el.id)` BEFORE wiping #cmd-list, then re-applies `el.open = true` AFTER render for each previously-open id that still exists. Verified test: expand 2 <details class="cmd"> elements, call renderTasks() from the browser console, both remain open.

localStorage v2 persistence still works: open 2 <details class="cmd"> rows, reload the page on file://, the same 2 are open. localStorage key is `codexu-overview-details-state-v2` (plans/overview.html ~line 3106).

Today-panel verification: after data-file edit changing one of the 3 ported tasks' phase to 'impl-in-progress', a single page reload places that task in the Today panel's Running section (#today-running) with no console errors, confirming buildTodayPanel() still classifies the freshly-emitted DOM correctly.

Existing IIFEs (renderPhaseBadges, injectTaskScopeChips, counts, filters, URL banner, spawn injection, run history, localStorage v2 persistence) continue to function against the freshly-emitted DOM for the 3 ported tasks. Verified: ?tasks=perf-WS3 URL filter shows exactly that task; counts in the header reflect 51 total command rows (3 from data + 48 from HTML).

Skeleton-ownership invariant respected: the diff in plans/overview-data.js shows ONLY additions to the tasks[] array body — no re-formatting of OVERVIEW_DATA's top-level braces, key order, or other top-level fields (phaseTree[], runs, periodic, etc.).
No two entries in OVERVIEW_DATA.tasks[] share the same id (verified by a quick console check or grep).
Containers exist: #kanban-ready, #kanban-soon, #kanban-blocked, #cmd-list, and #phase-tree are present in plans/overview.html (added in this story if not already present from US-001).
Typecheck passes.

Verify in browser using agent-browser skill: open plans/overview.html on file://, confirm the 3 ported tasks render correctly, expand+reload preserves open state, and ?tasks=<id> filtering works as described above.

planReviewContext.description: kanbanCards[] schema with only {column, titleHtml, subHtml} is insufficient for identical rendering. plans/overview.html has 33 .card-meta blocks with rich content (pills, icons, links, inline <code>); at least one card carries class="card closed" (extra class beyond .card); inline-style border-color and opacity are also in use. The 3-field schema cannot round-trip card-meta, additional card class names, or inline pills.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix:
Use the widened schema {column, cardClass: string|null, inlineStyle: string|null, html: string}. Render emits `
${html}
`. The `html` field carries the trusted full inner HTML of
.

planReviewContext.description: AC promises bookkeeper-workflow updates reflect in 'kanban placement, command-row badge, phase tree pill, and Today panel without further file edits' but does not include an explicit Today-panel verification step. If the data-driven render breaks Today-panel logic (which today walks DOM by class/data-attribute), the AC is unverifiable as a binary pass/fail.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Add an AC: 'After data-file edit changing a task's phase to impl-in-progress, the Today panel's Running section includes that task within one page reload without console errors. Verified by manual reload on file://.'

planReviewContext.description: AC requires 'same prompt bodies copy-pasteable from the clipboard' but does not specify the decode/re-emit strategy. Risk Areas section identifies HTML-entity decoding as Risk #1 but the AC is silent on implementation. Without an explicit AC, an autonomous implementer may use innerHTML for prompt bodies and re-encode entities, producing copy-paste output that contains '>' instead of '>'.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Add an AC: 'Prompt bodies in <pre class="cmd-pre"> render with HTML entities decoded to literal characters; render uses textContent (or DOM Node.textContent assignment), not innerHTML, for prompt strings. Verified by manual copy-paste check on first 3 + last 3 tasks: pasted text equals the JS string literal stored in tasks[].command.planPrompt.'

planReviewContext.description: AC says 'Expanding a <details class="cmd"> row, then re-firing the render preserves the open state' but lacks an explicit test procedure or interaction with the existing localStorage 'codexu-overview-details-state-v2' persistence (overview.html line 3106). An implementer might satisfy the snapshot/restore in-render but skip the localStorage re-apply, regressing cross-load persistence.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Replace with: 'After renderTasks() rebuilds the DOM, all <details class="cmd"> elements that were open before the re-render are still open. Additionally, the existing localStorage codexu-overview-details-state-v2 persistence still works: open 2 details, reload the page, the same 2 are open. Verified manually on file://.'
